sections.html:
• Type: Rhizomatous
  • Origin: Africa
  • Growth rate: Slow
  • Height: 20-30+ cm (average height after two months in the tank)
  • Light demand: Low
  • CO2: Low

Anubias barteri var. barteri from West Africa is an undemanding plant. It grows somewhat larger than Anubias barteri var. nana but is grown in the same conditions. It is 25-45 cm tall and the creeping rhizome is 10-15 cm or more. Anubias barteri varies considerably in terms of size and leaf shape.

Like other Anubias species, it is best planted in a shady spot to minimize algae growth on the leaves. If planted on the bottom, the rhizome must not be covered because it tends to rot.
It is also suitable for terrariums and paludariums. Herbivorous fish do not eat the very tough and robust leaves.
